The LAS export worker bundles the `laz-perf` 0.0.7 npm decoder and its WebAssembly
asset through Vite. It only decompresses source COPC nodes; exported LAS files
are uncompressed. This directory preserves its Apache-2.0 license in the static
distribution. License text: https://github.com/hobuinc/laz-perf/blob/3.4.0/COPYING.
